name_input: LABOTEK PLASTICS AUXILIARIES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of research date. Tooling was largely unavailable: the DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every query, Bing/Google returned irrelevant or blocked results, and Indian registry aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com) returned HTTP 403/404. Consequently NO primary-source verification was possible for this entity. What IS verifiable: the Danish parent Labotek A/S (Frederikssund, Denmark, VAT 87814416) operates a global distributor network and lists India among its sales/service countries on https://www.labotek.com/contact/global-presence/ — i.e. the Indian entity appears to be a sales/service subsidiary or distributor of plastics auxiliary equipment (dryers, dosing, conveying), consistent with the declared HS 8421/8481 class. No sanctions exposure found, but this is NOT a cleared result: OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List screens were not successfully executed, so sanctions_hit is null (unknown), not false. No Indian court cases (NCLT, DRT, High Court, consumer forums), no regulator actions (RBI, SEBI, GST, EPFO, customs), no credit rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings — the entity is a small private company and is unlikely to be rated) and no negative news could be retrieved or confirmed; all set to null rather than guessed. No evidence of supplies to Russia or CIS found — and equally no evidence of absence; rf_supply null. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground and no rejection is proposed. RECOMMENDATION: re-run this screen when search access is restored, specifically against the OFAC SDN list, the EU consolidated list, the UK OFSI list, the BIS Entity List, and e-courts/NCLT/IBBI by the entity's actual CIN (CIN not confirmed here and deliberately not invented).
